edges.label: Schmitt drafted and embargoed the 2002 Haut affidavit
edges.note: Schmitt composed and emailed the text; Haut signed it at the International UFO Museum before his daughter Julie Shuster and a notary; it was withheld until after Haut's death in 2005 and published in 'Witness to Roswell' (2007).

edges.label: Haut's 8 July 1947 press release named Marcel as the recovering officer
edges.note: The Roswell Army Air Field release, written by PIO Walter Haut on Col. Blanchard's order, identified the intelligence officer responsible. This is the only same-week official document naming a custodian of the material.
